description: Mexico 2023 broadcasting service coverage analysis is provided by IFT. The recurring IFT report assesses AM, FM and digital terrestrial television coverage in Mexico using 4,215 authorised stations. The 2023 edition uses a station cut-off of 8 January 2024 and reports population coverage nationally and by state. Geographic context: national; Mexico. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. The cited material was readable without payment. Reuse licence: Not stated on the reviewed page; check provider terms before reuse. The IFT website now labels itself a historical archive; the report describes potential reception, not measured reception at every household. Potential simulation use: Compare national broadcast availability and coverage-planning assumptions.
